MODEL: no model lines. Review-S1 standards fix: flow test is *IntegrationTest, so plain `mvn test` does not start compose; a full `mvn verify` starts it in the Failsafe JVM only.
CHOICES: none. Left the test body and pom as they were.
NOT CHECKED: full unit suite; full `mvn verify` (compose-once across the whole suite not timed). Did not re-run `-Dtest=PlaceOrderFlow*` to completion.
